objective: Avoid conflating healthy adult autonomic ageing with developmental, reproductive, disease-related or fitness-related physiology.

current_dataset.name: PhysioNet Autonomic Aging v1.0.0
current_dataset.clinical_conditions: excluded by published eligibility criteria; not individually coded in released metadata
current_dataset.limitations: Any unrecorded clinical characteristic is UNKNOWN; never infer 'negative' from missing data, sex code, age or healthy-volunteer label.

priority_populations.label: pregnancy and postpartum
priority_populations.protocol: distinct obstetric cohort; trimester- and postpartum-specific reference ranges

priority_populations.label: pre-, peri- and postmenopause
priority_populations.protocol: stratify reproductive status without treating chronological age or sex code as a proxy

priority_populations.label: coronary artery disease, PCI and stents
priority_populations.protocol: disease-specific external cohort; do not use as reference healthy ageing baseline

priority_populations.label: infants, children and adolescents
priority_populations.protocol: separate developmental model and age-specific normative ranges; do not extrapolate adult model

priority_populations.label: endurance, strength and recreational athletes
priority_populations.protocol: training-specific strata; avoid using low heart rate or high HRV as labels for athletic status

guardrails: No child, pregnant, postmenopausal, athlete, or stent subgroup claims from this dataset unless phenotype was independently ascertained.
No low HRV = accelerated ageing; no high HRV = longevity inference.
Coronary stent implantation is a treatment history, not a sex or gender category.
No pediatric claims from adult participants.
No population-specific diagnostic cutoffs without independent validation.
Longitudinal clinical outcomes required for longevity or risk prediction claims.
